title: fix(console): keep the browser copies of favorites, recents, last app and the pinned list view per organization
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_
Fixes #36244

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 同时属于两个组织的用户，用同一个浏览器切换组织后，不再在新组织里先看到旧组织的收藏、最近访问、上次应用和固定视图；单组织与无组织部署的用户原有内容保留。
- 为个人设置清点中您接受的建议（p2）：浏览器里的副本跟服务器一样按组织分开保存。
- 出错时最坏是某个组织里的收藏或固定视图首次显示为空、等服务器读回后恢复；不涉及他人数据，撤回本改动即回到原行为。
- 无（交接模式提交：本地测试未跑完，等 CI 结论）。

## What changes

- `scopedKey(base, userId, orgId?)` (`UserStateAdapters`) spells `BASE:u:USER:o:ORG` when an organization is active; without one (no organization feature, a preview, the boot before an organization is known) it is the user-only key as before.
- The organization is `ActiveOrganizationStorage`'s id, read synchronously (`useOrganizationScope`): the same id the console stamps on the `sys_user_preference` reads as `X-Tenant-ID`, and the one `switchOrganization` stores before the switch reloads the console, so the first paint after a switch reads the new organization's copy.
- `FavoritesProvider`, `RecentItemsProvider`, `LastAppProvider`, `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider` read and write their browser copy under that key, and re-load when the organization changes. `FavoritesProvider`'s hydrate push-back now reads this organization's local copy, so it can only carry this organization's own nav-pin extras into its row.
- The pinned list view (`list.view.pinned`) is read through `usePinnedListView` (new, `views/pinnedListView.ts`), whose slot is `os:pref:list.view.pinned@object:OBJECT@org:ORG`. Only this preference is keyed this way; the `os:pref` mechanism and every other workspace preference are unchanged.
- **Carry-over rule (Done-when 4):** an organization that finds no copy of its own adopts the copy kept before the organization was part of the key (the user-only `ui.*` copy, and the per-object pin slot): the value moves under that organization's key and the old key is removed, so exactly one organization, the first to read it, inherits it. A single-organization person keeps everything; a deployment with no organization keeps the user-only key unchanged. The first reader is in practice the organization the old copy mirrors: every hydrate rewrote it with the active organization's row, and the first page-load on this code boots into the organization the browser last held.
- Sign-out and change-of-user purges are allowlist sweeps (`@object-ui/auth`); the new keys are not on either allowlist, so they are swept exactly as today's are. A pin in `signOutPurge.test.tsx` holds that for all five new spellings.

## Tests

Reach measured once, before the fix, with a unit harness (no running console with two memberships in this container): real `ActiveOrganizationStorage`, a fake server answering one `ui.favorites` row per stamped organization, favorite + nav pin in A, switch (remount) to B. On base `c30ce97c`:

- B's first paint: `["object:a_obj","nav:a_menu"]` (A's list).
- B's server row after hydrate: `["nav:a_menu"]` (A's nav pin pushed into B).
- Pinned view: B read `"pv_in_org_a"`; after pinning in B, back in A read `"pv_in_org_b"`; one key `os:pref:list.view.pinned@object:crm_lead`.

Both mechanisms reproduce. New pins: `FavoritesProvider.test.tsx`, `RecentItemsProvider.test.tsx`, `FlowPaletteRecentsProvider.test.tsx` (new top-level describes), `LastAppProvider.test.tsx` (new, no harness existed), `views/pinnedListView-36244.test.tsx`, `signOutPurge.test.tsx`.

**NOT MEASURED locally**: the new and touched test files, the four ablations (scopedKey ignoring the organization; no adoption; pin slot ignoring the organization; no pin adoption) and the app-shell type-check were scripted but never got a turn on the shared verify lock before the handover; CI's `Test UI` / `Type Check UI` are the first reading.

## Acceptance notes

- The `os:pref:*` pin slot carries no user. The organization in the slot does not change that, but a different account signing in on the same browser runs the change-of-user purge, which sweeps every `os:pref:*` key, so a second account does not read the first's pin.
- On a browser that holds no active organization yet (first boot, or after the server answered none), the copy is the user-only one until the organization resolves, then the organization adopts it; that boot window also costs one extra preference read when the organization arrives.
- Quiet hours (`notificationPreferences`) still use the user-only key: out of this card.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/pinnedListView-36244.test.tsx` — 3 passing tests expected.

Files to read first: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/UserStateAdapters.tsx` (`readScopedCopy`, `useOrganizationScope`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/pinnedListView.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx` (hydrate).

Local gates: 36 of 37 derived `check:*` families exit 0; `check:type-check-debt` NOT MEASURED (its closure build never got the lock); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` not run.
